Ficar sem atualizações deixa o PC expost: Going without updates leaves the PC exposed to security flaws Microsoft has already fixed. That's why the app doesn't offer to turn Windows Update off for good. Security only postpones only feature updates (new Windows versions) for 365 days using the official DeferFeatureUpdatesPeriodInDays policy. Pause uses the same values as the Settings app, limited to 35 days. Everything can be undone.
